book.name: 2 TESALONIKE
book.title: MUKAANA A POOLE WU A MYELE KUNDAA BASI TESALONIKE

content: Mandagha ma maamoŋono nsomo Mfumu agya
Bandughu mu kana, mu mi mitala oyabvughuru o Mfumu Yiisu-Kriste ya obvuŋunu o bihi-a-be ya nde, bihi liluomo be bu:

ka lisa o kuulu ti bitsimi bi be bigwimi maswa-maswa mu nkooro a ndagha yi osuo mufulu, mu ndagha nga-mõ bwunu we mu nkooro a mukaana wu baalyele ti kundaa bihi aafi, wu li mu okalyele ti etsughu e Mfumu eeto.
Mbwuru anyaã opfiri be mu ndagha si mõ. Nsomo etsughu ekye egya, baara sa batemene a Nzaami nsumu, ya Mbwuru wu Mubi wu obyii sa amoŋono.
Nde sa atemene nsumu ya byene bi baakata ti nzaami, bwunu we byehene bi baakasyighi. Nde sa ato tee mu eteese kii oyibwa nsini mu Nzo a Nzaami, ya ki olyele ndeme ti nde me Nzaami.
Be ka lili mu olibili mweẽ o ti me áli andyele be ndagha yi ŋa ándi me nkini kundaa be?
Ya mu matala ma be ligyighili osoolo emakye eli mu okakwara nde, mpaala nde amoŋono yini a mu matala ma bákuru.
Mu kuulu mansweghe ma bubi mali mu okabulusala, lo sa masomo mu osala ku obvulu ŋa odzimini munde wu li mu okakwara nde.
Mu obo Mbwuru wu Mubi sa amoŋono, lo Mfumu Yiisu sa adzwa nde mu mufulu a muŋma a nde ya sa akala adzihibi nde mu matala ma aamoŋono nde.
Ogya o Mbwuru wu Mubi sa omoŋono mu lileene lili Satana, mu mpaana yi mawa-mawa, mu bilyimi ya bimaã bibi mpya,
ya mu opfiri kuu mawa-mawa ya ogwene ku bunsumu kundaa babo ba baagwuŋumu, mu kuulu bo ka baagyagha dzyi lili engaŋma liili áli likughu obvwuhu bo o.
Me mu obo Nzaami li mu ogweghe bo mufulu wu ogwuŋumu mpaala basa kana mu mpya,
mu kuulu basa muyala kundaa baara bwohono baala ka baasi kana mu engaŋma o, lo baala baamono esee mu okagyighili mandagha mama gwene a bunsumu.

Bandughu mu kana ba ookadzyi Mfumu, bihi me baala lifaana okabvurulu matuono kundaa Nzaami matala mwohono mu nkooro a be. Mu kuulu, Nzaami ásuolo be mu okala baba nsomo mu obvwughu, mpaala be libvwughu mu libaha li Mufulu wu aakasa ti be likala baba ngili ya likala a kana mu engaŋma.
Nzaami áti behe si mbili mu nzili a Nsia yi Mbwe yi líluo bihi be, mpaala be libagha nsia a Mfumu a bihi Yiisu-Kriste.
Me mu obo, bandughu mu kana, lisa mukama ya likwara maluo ma liiluo bihi be, ngu okala mu mbiili bwunu we mu mukaana.
Nyaã Mfumu a bihi Yiisu-Kriste ndeme ya Nzaami Taara a bihi, wu áadzyi bihi ya wuulu mu bwehe bu nde, aagwi bihi mpama yi a mibvu ya mibvu ya emiini ki ebwe,
bagwa be mpama ya mpini mu okasa bigyighili bi bibwe ya mbiili yi mbwe matala mwohono!
